label: Classical Daoism contested Mencius' normative moral cultivation, championing spontaneous naturalness (Ziran) over prescriptive virtues
description: Zhuangzi (Chuang Tzu) formulated a fundamental critique of "Innate Goodness of Human Nature (Xing Shan)", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Innate Goodness of Human Nature (Xing Shan)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Eastern & Axial Traditions.
